items.title: Skapta
items.blurb: Describe a project in plain English, get a recommended stack and a ready-to-run codebase.
items.summary: Describe a project in plain English and get a recommended stack plus a downloadable, pre-configured codebase. The retrieval pipeline scrapes real docs, embeds them with sentence-transformers, stores them in Pinecone and reranks results before generating. A labeled 15-case eval set scores the recommendations.
items.imageAlt: Skapta recommending a stack for a textbook marketplace: Next.js, Node.js with Express, PostgreSQL, Auth0 and Railway, each with a short reason.

items.title: Hanover CMS
items.blurb: A cloud prototype for Hanover Insurance, built in eight weeks by a 10-person team where I was assistant lead.
items.summary: A cloud web app prototype built for Hanover Insurance by a 10-person Agile team in eight weeks. As assistant lead I owned AI content search, bulk CMS uploads, the inline file viewer, role-based permissions and review notifications, and reviewed the team's pull requests.
items.imageAlt: The Content Management page: a searchable list of documents with type, category and status filters, deadlines and overdue flags.

items.title: Pi Cluster
items.blurb: A K3s cluster of Raspberry Pis that self-hosts my services. I'm currently refactoring it to network boot (PXE).
items.summary: A multi-node Raspberry Pi cluster running K3s to orchestrate containerized services. Self-hosts a web server, with WireGuard VPN for remote access. I handle OS updates and node recovery myself.

items.title: Vuln Scanner
items.blurb: A CLI that probes for exposed endpoints and missing security headers, then writes a report.
items.summary: A CLI that probes sensitive endpoints like /admin, .env and backup files, audits missing HTTP security headers, and writes structured vulnerability reports.
items.imageAlt: VulnScanner in Windows Terminal, scanning a deliberately misconfigured local test site: missing security headers, an exposed .env file with an AWS key and database password, an open directory listing and a SQL dump.

items.title: Wildfire Prediction
items.blurb: Predicting acres burned by California wildfires from a small dataset.
